name: Cataclysm
note: What this expansion ADDED, from tools/spell-ids/cata.json. Spells carried over from earlier expansions are not repeated here.

Warrior.name: Inner Rage
Warrior.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Strike and Cleave by 50% for 15 sec.

Warrior.name: Colossus Smash
Warrior.desc: Smashes a target for 150% weapon damage plus 120 and weakens their defenses, allowing your attacks to entirely bypass 100% of their armor for 6 sec. Bypasses less armor on players. [Glyph of Colossus Smash: Your Colossus Smash also applies the Sunder Armor effect to your target]

Warrior.name: Rallying Cry
Warrior.desc: Temporarily grants you and all party or raid members within 30 yards 20% of maximum health for 10 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

Warrior.name: Heroic Leap
Warrior.desc: Leap through the air towards a targeted location, slamming down with destructive force to deal (1 + 0.5 * Attack power) damage on all enemies within 8 yards.

Paladin.name: Word of Glory
Paladin.desc: Consumes all Holy Power to heal a friendly target for [((1809 + 2015) / 2) + 0.198 * Attack power] [Glyph of the Long Word: plus [(1809 + 2015) / 2] over 6 sec]per charge of Holy Power.

Paladin.name: Inquisition
Paladin.desc: Consumes all Holy Power to increase your Holy Damage by 30%. Lasts 4 sec per charge of Holy Power consumed.

Paladin.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
Paladin.desc: [Holy Shock: Summons a Guardian of Ancient Kings to protect you for 30 sec. While active, your next 5 direct heals will cause the Guardian to heal the same target for the amount healed by your heal, and friendly targets within 10 yards of the target for 10% of the amount healed] [Avenger's Shield: Summons a Guardian of Ancient Kings to protect you for 12 sec. While the Guardian is active, all incoming damage is reduced by 50%] [Templar's Verdict: Summons a Guardian of Ancient Kings to attack your current target for 30 sec. While active, your and your Guardian's attacks cause you to be infused with Ancient Power, increasing your Strength by 1% per application. After 30 sec or when your Guardian is killed, you will release Ancient Fury, causing 208 damage plus 208 per application of Ancient Power, divided among all targets within 10 yards / Select a talent specialization in order to activate Guardian of Ancient Kings.]

Hunter.name: Trap Launcher
Hunter.desc: When used, your next Trap can be launched to a target location within 40 yards. Lasts for 15 sec.

Hunter.name: Cobra Shot
Hunter.desc: Deals weapon damage plus [277 + (Ranged attack power * 0.017)] in the form of Nature damage and increases the duration of your Serpent Sting on the target by 6 sec. Generates 9 Focus.

Hunter.name: Aspect of the Fox
Hunter.desc: The Hunter takes on the aspects of a fox, allowing him to shoot Steady Shot and Cobra Shot while moving and causing him to gain [((2))] Focus whenever he receives a melee attack.

Hunter.name: Camouflage
Hunter.desc: You blend into your surroundings, causing you and your pet to be untargetable by ranged attacks. Also reduces the range at which enemy creatures can detect you, and provides stealth while stationary. You can lay traps while camouflaged, but any damage done by you or your pet will cancel the effect. Cannot be cast while in combat. Lasts for 1 min.

Rogue.name: Recuperate
Rogue.desc: Finishing move that consumes combo points on any nearby target to restore [Improved Recuperate: 4] [3.5 / 3]% of maximum health every 3 sec. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 6 seconds 2 points: 12 seconds 3 points: 18 seconds 4 points: 24 seconds 5 points: 30 seconds

Rogue.name: Combat Readiness
Rogue.desc: Enter into a state of heightened awareness, deflecting enemy weapon strikes with increasing effectiveness. Successive attacks will deal 10% less damage per application, stacking 5 times. Lasts for 20 sec, but if 10 sec elapse without any incoming weapon strikes, this state will end.

Rogue.name: Redirect
Rogue.desc: Transfers any existing combo points to the current enemy target [Bandit's Guile: as well as any insight gained from Bandit's Guile] [as well as any insight gained from Bandit's Guile] [as well as any insight gained from Bandit's Guile]. Requires active combo points.

Rogue.name: Smoke Bomb
Rogue.desc: Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around the Rogue for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud.

Priest.name: Mind Spike
Priest.desc: Blasts the target for 1114 Shadowfrost damage, but extinguishes your Shadow damage-over-time effects from the target in the process. Mind Spike also increases the critical strike chance of your next Mind Blast on the target by 30%. Stacks up to 3 times.

Priest.name: Inner Will
Priest.desc: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, reducing the mana cost of instant cast spells by 15% and increasing your movement speed by 10%. You can only have Inner Will or Inner Fire active at a time.

Priest.name: Leap of Faith
Priest.desc: You pull the spirit of the friendly party or raid target to you, instantly moving them directly in front of you.

Shaman.name: Unleash Elements
Shaman.desc: Focuses the elemental force imbued in the Shaman's weaponry, with the concentrated effects depending on the enchantment unleashed. [Dual Wield: If the same enchantment is present on both weapons, only one will be unleashed] See individual weapon imbue spell tooltips for details regarding the effects of unleashing each.

Shaman.name: Healing Rain
Shaman.desc: Calls forth healing rains to blanket the area targeted by the Shaman, restoring 756 health to allies in the area every 2 sec for 10 sec. Healing effectiveness diminishes for each player beyond 6 within the area.

Shaman.name: Spiritwalker's Grace
Shaman.desc: Calls upon spiritual guidance, permitting movement while casting non-instant Shaman spells. This spell may be cast while casting other spells. Lasts 15 sec.

Mage.name: Flame Orb
Mage.desc: Launches a Flame Orb forward from the Mage's position, dealing 261 Fire damage every second to the closest enemy target for 15 secs [Fire Power: and exploding for 1236 at the end of its duration] [with a 66% chance to explode for 1236 at the end of its duration] [with a 33% chance to explode for 1236 at the end of its duration].

Mage.name: Time Warp
Mage.desc: Warp the flow of time, increasing melee, ranged, and spell casting speed by 30% for all party and raid members. Lasts 40 sec. Allies receiving this effect will become unstuck in time, and be unable to benefit from Bloodlust, Heroism, or Time Warp again for 10 min.

Warlock.name: Soulburn
Warlock.desc: Consumes a Soul Shard, allowing you to use the secondary effects on some of your spells. Drain Life Summon Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter, Felguard Demonic Circle: Teleport Soul Fire Healthstone Searing Pain [Soulburn: Seed of Corruption: Seed of Corruption]

Warlock.name: Fel Flame
Warlock.desc: Deals 239 Shadowflame damage to an enemy target, increasing the duration of Immolate or Unstable Affliction by 6 sec.

Warlock.name: Dark Intent
Warlock.desc: You link yourself with the targeted friendly target, increasing both of your haste by 3%. When you or the linked target gains a critical periodic damage or healing effect, the other gains increased periodic damage and healing lasting for 7 sec. You gain 3%, while the target gains 1%. Stacks up to 3 times. Dark Intent lasts for 30 min.

Warlock.name: Demon Soul
Warlock.desc: You and your summoned demon fuse souls, granting the Warlock a temporary power depending on the demon currently enslaved. Imp - Critical strike chance of your cast time Destruction spells increased by 30% for 20 sec. Voidwalker - All threat generated by you transferred to your Voidwalker for 15 sec. Succubus - Shadow Bolt damage increased by 10% for 20 sec. Felhunter - Periodic shadow damage increased by 20% for 20 sec. Felguard - Spell haste increased by 15% and fire and shadow damage done increased by 10% for 20 sec.

Druid.name: Thrash
Druid.desc: Deals (Attack power * 0.0982 + 933) to (Attack power * 0.0982 + 1151) damage, and causes all targets within 8 yards to bleed for [(Attack power * 0.0167 + 1) * 3] damage over 6 sec.

Druid.name: Stampeding Roar
Druid.desc: The Druid roars, increasing the movement speed of all friendly players within 10 yards by 60% for 8 sec.

Druid.name: Wild Mushroom
Druid.desc: Grow a magical Mushroom with 5 Health at the target location. After 6 sec, the Mushroom will become invisible. When detonated by the Druid, all Mushrooms will explode dealing 934 Nature damage to all nearby enemies within 6 yards. Only 3 Mushrooms can be placed at one time. Use Wild Mushroom: Detonate to detonate all Mushrooms.

Death Knight.name: Outbreak
Death Knight.desc: Instantly applies Blood Plague and Frost Fever to the target enemy.

Death Knight.name: Necrotic Strike
Death Knight.desc: A vicious strike that deals 100% weapon damage and absorbs the next (0.70 * Attack power) healing received by the target. For 10 sec, or until the full amount of healing is absorbed, the target's casting time is increased by 30%.

Death Knight.name: Dark Simulacrum
Death Knight.desc: Places a dark ward on an enemy that persists for 8 sec, triggering when the enemy next spends mana on a spell, and allowing the Death Knight to unleash an exact duplicate of that spell. Against nonplayers, only absorbs some harmful spells.
